question: Which of the following is NOT a part of the electoral college of the president of India?

options.text: Elected members of legislative assemblies of states

solution:
The correct answer is __**Governor of States.**__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**
